description_html:
My guest today is Martin Casado, General Partner at Andreessen Horowitz. 

Martin has spent three decades building and investing in technology infrastructure. We discuss why traditional approaches to investing often fail to capture disruptive technologies, how AI is reshaping the economics of software, and why the ability to turn capital directly into technological progress may be the most important change of all. Martin also shares lessons from some of his biggest investments and acquisitions. 

Please enjoy this conversation with Martin Casado.

For the full show notes, transcript, and links to mentioned content, check out the episode page here.
